name: breakouts
description: A focused SCSS/CSS breakout layout toolkit inspired by the Mulligan named-grid pattern.

scripts.build: sass src/_index.scss dist/breakouts.css --style=expanded && sass src/_index.scss dist/breakouts.min.css --style=compressed && cp dist/breakouts.css docs/breakouts.css
scripts.release:patch: (npm whoami || npm login --auth-type=web) && npm run build && npm version patch --sign-git-tag && npm publish --access public && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: (npm whoami || npm login --auth-type=web) && npm run build && npm version minor --sign-git-tag && npm publish --access public && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: (npm whoami || npm login --auth-type=web) && npm run build && npm version major --sign-git-tag && npm publish --access public && git push --follow-tags

author: Cantilux
